AtsCheck.title: Is your CV ATS-proof?
AtsCheck.subtitle: Nine in ten large companies use an Applicant Tracking System to pre-filter CVs. A great-looking CV the ATS can't parse never reaches a recruiter. Upload your CV, get a score and concrete improvements.
AtsCheck.vacancyPlaceholder: Paste the job description to see how well your CV matches...
AtsCheck.vacancyHint: Compares the words in the job description with your CV — gives a match percentage.
AtsCheck.matchKeywords: Keywords from the job description missing in your CV
AtsCheck.matchPercent: {percent}% of the keywords in the job description appear in your CV.
AtsCheck.newCvSubtitle: Our CV builder produces text-selectable PDFs that every ATS can read. Recruiter-grade typography, 6 templates, instant download.
AtsCheck.checkTextBody: A PDF made of images — for example one made in Canva or via screenshot — is blank to ATS systems. We verify your CV contains real text.
AtsCheck.checkSectionsBody: ATS links information to section headers. "Experience", "Education" and "Skills" — without them the system doesn't know what it's reading.
AtsCheck.checkContactBody: Email and phone must be machine-readable, not hidden in an image.
AtsCheck.checkLengthBody: 400-900 words on 1-2 pages is the standard. Too short raises doubts; too long gets skipped.
AtsCheck.checkMatchBody: Paste a job description to see how many of the required keywords appear in your CV. ATS uses this match to rank candidates.

CoverLetterDetail.label: Cover Letter Example
CoverLetterDetail.heroBody: Example cover letter for a {functie} application. The structure — greeting, opening, body, closing — is what UK recruiters expect. Use as a starting point and adapt to your own experience and the vacancy.
CoverLetterDetail.wantOneBody: Start from this example and add your own details. Ready in 5 minutes.
CoverLetterDetail.disclaimer: This is a fictional example. Company names and details are illustrative. Use as a template for your own application.
CoverLetterDetail.howToTitle: How to write a strong cover letter as a {functie}
CoverLetterDetail.howToSubtitle: The four standard blocks — and what to put in each.
CoverLetterDetail.block1Body: In one sentence name the specific role and company. In the second sentence note where you saw the vacancy if relevant. Avoid generic openers like 'I am writing to apply for your position'.
CoverLetterDetail.block2Body: This is where you make the match. Take two or three concrete elements from your background that map one-to-one to the vacancy. For {functie}: mention results in numbers (where possible), specific systems, certifications or projects.
CoverLetterDetail.block3Body: One or two sentences on why you specifically want to work there. Concrete and specific: a product, a strategic move, a cultural marker.
CoverLetterDetail.block4Body: Ask for an interview. State your availability. Sign off with 'Yours sincerely'. Total length: 250-400 words, one page.
